[EN] You're kind. Horse is kind. You're mean. Horse is mean.

If you want to taste wind as you travel, be kind. If you want to taste grass, don't.
[ES] Eres amable. El caballo es amable. Eres malo. El caballo es malo.

Si quieres saborear el viento al viajar, sé amable. Si quieres saborear el pasto, no lo seas.
